scaffold.message: Your budget stays on this device.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.updates: Your budget data stays on this device and is never sent anywhere. Each time the app starts (store and TestFlight versions), it checks for app updates with Expo, the update service; this is the only connection the app makes. Each check sends a random installation ID stored on this device, technical details of the installed version (platform, runtime version, update channel, update IDs) and, after a crash, the error message. Deleting the app removes the ID, but restoring a device backup can bring it back. Expo also sees your IP address. The app does not track you and has no ads or analytics.

steps.restart: If that doesn’t help, restart your phone and open Budget Lens again.
steps.checkUpdate: Check {{store}} for a newer version of Budget Lens.
steps.lastResort: As a last resort, start over with a new, empty budget. Your current budget file stays on this phone, encrypted.

keyMissing.title: Can’t unlock your budget
keyMissing.body: Your budget is still on this phone, but the key that unlocks it is missing. This usually happens after restoring the phone from a backup or moving to a new phone.
keyMissing.step1: Tap Try again, in case this was a one-off problem.
keyMissing.step2: If your budget is still on your previous phone, keep using it there.
keyMissing.step3: Or start over with a new, empty budget. Your old budget file stays on this phone, encrypted, but Budget Lens can’t open it.
keyMissing.confirmTitle: Start over with an empty budget?
keyMissing.confirmBody: Your current data can’t be opened without the missing key. It will stay on this phone, encrypted, but won’t appear in the app. You’ll set up Budget Lens again from the beginning.

storageUnreachable.title: Secure storage isn’t responding
storageUnreachable.body: Budget Lens keeps your budget encrypted and stores the key in this phone’s secure storage. Right now the phone isn’t letting the app read it, so your budget can’t be opened. Nothing has been changed.
storageUnreachable.step1: Unlock your phone and tap Try again.
storageUnreachable.step2: Restart your phone, then open Budget Lens again.
storageUnreachable.step3: Make sure your phone has some free storage space.
storageUnreachable.step4: If nothing helps, start over with a new, empty budget. Your current budget file stays on this phone, encrypted.
storageUnreachable.confirmTitle: Start over with an empty budget?
storageUnreachable.confirmBody: Your current budget will be set aside on this phone, still encrypted. This version of Budget Lens can’t bring it back, so do this only if Try again keeps failing.
storageUnreachable.startOverBlocked: Starting over isn’t possible while secure storage isn’t responding. Nothing has been changed. Restart your phone and try again.

migrationFailed.title: Couldn’t finish updating your budget
migrationFailed.body: The app was updated, but moving your budget to the new version didn’t finish. Your budget was put back exactly as it was before, so nothing is lost.

restoreFailed.body: The app was updated, but moving your budget to the new version didn’t finish, and putting the earlier version back didn’t work either. A safe copy of your budget is still on this phone, encrypted, and nothing has been written over it.

stateUnrecognized.title: Couldn’t open your budget
stateUnrecognized.body: Something unexpected happened while opening your budget. Budget Lens hasn’t changed or deleted anything.

encryptionUnavailable.title: This version can’t protect your budget
encryptionUnavailable.body: This copy of Budget Lens was built without encryption, so it won’t open or save your budget. Your budget hasn’t been changed.
encryptionUnavailable.step1: Install the latest version of Budget Lens from {{store}}.
encryptionUnavailable.step2: Then open the app again. Your budget will be there.
encryptionUnavailable.noStartOver: Starting over wouldn’t help here: a new budget couldn’t be encrypted either.

status.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing has been changed.
